test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Make sure you known how to swim.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error is in option 4) **"you known".**
 
• The** correct form** should be **"you know".**
 
• This is because the verb **"know"** needs to be in the present tense to match with **"you"**, forming the present tense declarative sentence.
 
• **"Known" **is the past participle of **"know**" and is typically used in perfect tenses or as an adjective, neither of which applies here.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is-* 'Make sure **you know **how to swim'.*
